Flèches : glisser · Retour arrière : ann: Arrows: slide · Backspace: undo · R: restart · H: hint · P: pause
Sur la glace, le pingouin ne s'arrête pa: On ice, the penguin cannot stop: it slides to the next rock or to the edge. Snow stops it dead. Get it to the flag. Three stars if you find the shortest path, two if you need two more moves. A hint shows the right move, but the level is then worth one star.
